text: Recipe re-verified: travel tutor_room PASS -> click machine (1195,1150) -> 选择楼层 (1484,887) -> preset 1 (1895,795) -> inside floor 01 -> click guardian sprite at (1220,800) twice -> battle starts (当前回合：1). Note: the precise sprite centre is ~(1220,800); (1190,760) missed once.

2nd floor-1 clear: victory panel -> 5 sequential 确认 clicks ((1191,997),(1188,999),(1198,983),(1198,983),(1198,988)) -> floor number 01 -> 02. Post-victory handling took 13.8 s; entry (preset->battle) ~7 s; battle 2 turns.

Floor 2 guardian LV84 巴鲁斯, won in 2 turns. Verbatim: 'XIN精灵获得经验：3003'; '成功升级到了42级' + '等级：+1 体力：+3 攻击：+2 防守：+2 特攻：+2 特防：+2 速度：+3'; '恭喜你得到了24个积累经验'; '恭喜你得到了200个XIN豆'; '1个神奇扭蛋牌已经放入你的储存箱！'. Floor 02 -> 03. PP 火焰车 16->15->14 (1 per floor). Level 42, HP max 125.

Client left INSIDE the tower at floor 03 (tower interior has no bottom bar, so travel-based loops cannot start from here - tower_grind must either continue from inside or the operator must exit first). Lv42 HP 125, PP 火焰车 14/25, idle, frontmost, no modal, no loop.
